# procps compatibility — `org.ono.compat.procps`

Version `0.1.0`; process.exec executables: `ps`. Everything below is the pack's contract; an invocation not listed under an adapter runs raw, and the limits state what the adapted form does not carry.

## ps — `org.ono.compat.procps.ps`

Processes as `ono.process/1` records, from `ps -o` with an explicit field list.

| | |
|---|---|
| executable | `ps` |
| versions | `>=3.3` |
| tier | B — stable machine-readable format |
| schema | `ono.process/1` |
| decoder | `lines` |
| demand | structured, interactive |
| fallback | raw |
| fixtures | `procps/ps` |

### Supported invocations

| invocation | runs as | flags allowed | flags required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ps aux\|ax\|axu — every process` | `ps -e -o pid=,ppid=,user=,stat=,pcpu=,rss=,vsz=,nlwp=,etimes=,args=` | — | — |
| `ps -e\|-A\|-ef\|-ejH — every process` | `ps -e -o pid=,ppid=,user=,stat=,pcpu=,rss=,vsz=,nlwp=,etimes=,args=` | `-e`, `-A`, `-ef`, `-f`, `-F`, `-l`, `-j`, `-H`, `--forest`, `-w`, `-ww` | `-e` |
| `ps -A — every process` | `ps -e -o pid=,ppid=,user=,stat=,pcpu=,rss=,vsz=,nlwp=,etimes=,args=` | `-A`, `-f`, `-F`, `-l`, `-j`, `-H`, `--forest`, `-w`, `-ww` | `-A` |
| `ps [-u\|-U <user>] [-p\|--pid <pid,…>] [-C <name>] [-t <tty>] [-g\|-G <group>] — a selection` | `ps -o pid=,ppid=,user=,stat=,pcpu=,rss=,vsz=,nlwp=,etimes=,args=` | `-f`, `-F`, `-l`, `-j`, `-H`, `--forest`, `-w`, `-ww`, `-u <value>`, `-U <value>`, `--user <value>`, `-p <value>`, `--pid <value>`, `--ppid <value>`, `-C <value>`, `-t <value>`, `--tty <value>`, `-g <value>`, `-G <value>`, `--group <value>`, `-s <value>`, `--sid <value>` | — |

### Fields

| field | from |
|---|---|
| `command` | `args` |
| `cpu` | `pcpu` |
| `memory` | `rss`, unit Kib |
| `name` | `args` |
| `pid` | `pid` |
| `ppid` | `ppid` |
| `started` | `etimes` |
| `state` | `stat` |
| `threads` | `nlwp` |
| `user` | `user` |
| `virtual_mem` | `vsz`, unit Kib |

### Limits

- `-o/--format`, `-L/-T` (threads) and `-O` change what a row is and are not adapted; the invocation runs raw.
- `name` is the program name inferred from `args`, not the kernel's `comm`; `executable`, `cwd`, `group`, `service` and `container` are not reported — `get process` answers them.
- `started` is inferred from the elapsed time ps reports, to the second.
